text.tspan: Module 2 — The Ccnd1 / Cdk6 loci: PRC2 / H3K27me3 governor of the mitogen-drive axis

EZH2 (cell-cycle-coupled writer) → PRC2 → me1 → me2 → me3 reservoir; proximal PRC2 loads only when Pol II stops; transcription evicts PRC2; replication dilutes; repression is leaky and governs Cyclin D1 AND CDK6
stable · banked in S/G2 and in arrest
cycle-coupled writer: EZH2 rises in S/G2,
is degraded in G0/G1, and is diluted at division
blocks the SET domain (WRITING) only — PRC2 stays bound,
existing mark decays over ~1 day (turnover + eraser + dilution)
DISTAL RESERVOIR = the broad H3K27me3 domain = the memory
eraser strips me3 → me2 → me1 (weak; Gli1-induced)
writer follows the CYCLE, eraser follows MITOGEN
EED reads me3 → recruits more PRC2 (cooperative read-write, self-reinforcing)
Module 4 · fork-gated · longer S dilutes more
me3 loss where the gene is transcribed
bound PRC2 represses (occupancy, not the mark)
LEAKY: dampens, never silences (Pol II stays)
double-negative: active locus stays poised; vismodegib arrest self-reinforces
PROXIMAL PRC2 at the TSS (the actual repressor in arrest):
loaded from the reservoir only while Pol II is NOT elongating (E2F low);
evicted by elongation → ≈0 in cycling cells (marked-but-expressed);
re-loads in sustained arrest → deeper, REVERSIBLE repression of Ccnd1 + Cdk6
same PRC2 repression as Ccnd1 (leaky floor) → CDK6 is the 2nd governed arm → Module 3 (INK4 sink)
